summary: Chainline keeps track of what wears out on every bike you own — and tells you before a worn chain eats your cassette.
features: Chain, cassette, chainrings, tyres, brake pads, sealant, cables, bar tape, suspension service, bearings
Wear by distance or by time, with a bar that turns amber when a part is due and red when it's time to replace
Starting limits for each part that you can change; check real wear with a chain checker too
Enter rides or set the odometer from your bike computer
Or import cycling workouts from Apple Health — Apple Watch, iPhone, or apps that save to Health
Every bike in the garage, kids' bikes included
Replace a part in one swipe — the service is logged for you
